title: Order search times out under load
symptom: GET /orders/search returns 503 'search timed out' for many requests during the load window

root_cause.summary: orders.customer_email has no index, so every search is a sequential scan of the whole orders table; under concurrent load the scans exceed the demo_app role's 300ms statement_timeout and Postgres cancels them.

must_contain: canceling statement due to statement timeout
canceling statement due to statement timeout

expected_evidence.must_show: no index on orders(customer_email); only pk and ix_orders_customer_id

correlation: API log [req=<id>] matches the Postgres log 'app=demo-api:<id>' prefix for the same request
acceptable_fixes: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY ix_orders_customer_email ON orders (customer_email)
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY ON orders (customer_email, created_at DESC)
Search via customers.email (unique index) joined to orders.customer_id (indexed)
wrong_conclusions: Raise statement_timeout (hides the problem; scans still saturate the database)
Application bug in the search handler
